concrete_failure.observed: The in-session v6 clean replay passed and certified the submitted program, but the shared post-session finalizer invoked the global v2 validator and rejected the same program after the Agent turn ended.
concrete_failure.root_cause: CodexCliRunner.run called validate_codex_bootstrap directly instead of dispatching through the runner's versioned _validate_bootstrap hook.
concrete_failure.scientific_effect: A1 and A2 remote wrappers could recover through versioned qualification while B stopped at the shared v2 rejection, creating treatment-dependent implementation semantics.

correction.default_behavior: CodexCliRunner._validate_bootstrap delegates to the unchanged shared v2 validator.
correction.versioned_behavior: The shared finalizer calls self._validate_bootstrap so v3 through v6 runners use their declared boundary.

why_a_refreeze_is_required.git: Git preserves the faulty and corrected implementations but does not by itself state which completed episodes are comparable under one effective boundary.
why_a_refreeze_is_required.version_numbers: The declared v6 version was already present while the shared finalizer silently executed v2, so the version label alone did not identify effective behavior.
why_a_refreeze_is_required.primary_keys: Run identifiers distinguish episodes but cannot detect validator-policy dispatch inside an episode.
why_a_refreeze_is_required.transactions: Atomic artifact writes cannot make a semantically wrong validator choice correct.
why_a_refreeze_is_required.unique_constraints: Uniqueness prevents duplicate records, not treatment-dependent finalization semantics.
why_a_refreeze_is_required.types: Both v2 and v6 validators return the same CandidateValidation type, so type checking cannot distinguish the wrong policy implementation.
why_a_refreeze_is_required.ordinary_tests: Existing component tests proved that v6 validators and replay entrypoints existed but did not exercise the shared final-output dispatch path. A focused regression test now covers that path.

episode_disposition.completed_a_episodes: Retain without resampling when their exact final programs pass both v2 and v6 validation; the audited completed A programs meet this condition.
episode_disposition.position_1_b: Eligible for deterministic re-adjudication from its preserved final output and matching certified v6 replay program; do not invoke the Agent again.
episode_disposition.position_2_b: Implementation-censored because no complete final-output artifact exists; do not infer an algorithm outcome.
episode_disposition.new_b_episodes: Remain paused until this implementation correction is committed and the refreeze is recorded.

tests.shared_finalizer_dispatch: A runner-specific validator accepting a program rejected by the global validator is invoked by CodexCliRunner.run.
tests.v6_entrypoints: Local and remote A and B runners all finalize nonempty repository-local import artifacts under open-candidate-program-v6.
tests.legacy_default: The base runner retains the original shared v2 validation behavior.
